queries.query: Ranipet Tamil Nadu official cadastral parcel map land records GIS survey portal
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Ranipet District Government of Tamil Nadu revenue service page, the Tamil Nadu official land-record e-services route, the Tamil Nadu Integrated Land Record announcement, and the official TNGIS web GIS portal. The sources describe land records/FMB/TSLR and GIS services, but did not expose a parcel vector endpoint in the accessible discovery content.
